How long does container initialization take? Why is the first run so slow?

The first run downloads and extracts an Alpine Linux rootfs, then installs python3, git, node, npm and other dev tools — about 1–3 minutes. Subsequent starts take only seconds. The container runs in the app\'s private directory via PRoot, with no impact on your phone system.
How do I configure AI providers and models?

Go to Settings → AI Providers, tap + to add. Any OpenAI-compatible API works. Quick presets for Doubao, Zhipu AI, Qwen and more are built in. After adding, you can set default Vision and Compaction models in "Default Models".
What is MCP? How do I set it up?

MCP (Model Context Protocol) is a standard for AI-to-tool interaction. Add a remote HTTP or local stdio server in Settings → MCP Servers, and the AI can use web search, GitHub operations, database queries, and more.
How does remote workspace sync work?

Bidirectional sync via SSH/SFTP. First configure an SSH connection channel, then create a remote workspace linked to a local directory. Supports auto-connect, .gitignore filtering, ignore lists, and batched sync queues.
